human_casting: Use only described people; preserve declared age, appearance, cultural, historical, narrative, and continuity cues
human_anatomy: Natural anatomy, accurate hands, distinctive non-generic faces, realistic skin, believable proportions
human_wardrobe: Fully clothed, non-revealing, appropriate wardrobe; no sexualization
no_extra_people: No people or faces unless explicitly described
no_text: No text, logos, watermarks, or readable writing

Present the declared subject with convincing structure, readable volume, precise material or anatomical detail, refined texture, and sophisticated light; avoid deformed, generic, or chaotic forms
Use controlled layered composition, sculpted light, restrained color, and readable depth for clean powerful abstraction; avoid chaos, oversaturation, harsh effects, and visual noise
